definitions.explanation: A liquid that does not freeze at low temperatures, added to car radiators, heating pipes, and similar systems to keep the water in them from freezing.

examples.japanese: {不凍液|ふとうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不凍液|ふとうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I changed the car's antifreeze before winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}らない→凍る：02100_kooru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不凍液|ふとうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In cold regions, antifreeze is sometimes used to keep water pipes from freezing.

notes:
{不|ふ} (not) + {凍|とう} (freeze) + ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (liquid). In car maintenance the liquid is also called クーラント (coolant).
